serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Could you tell me more about yourself? It’s my first time meeting a mechanical priest.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I was built by clerics from the HolyC order. Concept of my creation was prepared by his holiness John Paul 202. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: In the recent years a number of new cleric vocations dropped significantly. John Paul 202 troubled by this issue asked for holy intervention. After some time he took matters into his own hands and he started to learn how to code. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: At the beginning he picked up kava and anaconda, but after some first disappointments he resigned from this idea. Shortly after he met a man who would change his approach. Derry Tavis.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Derry Tavis told him that if he truly wants to master the art of  programming at the age of 90 he needs to start from the scratch. That’s how John Paul 202 started creating his own compiler.  
Ecclesiasticalot FF: This was just the beginning of his journey. In 2011 he…
You: Please! {{wi}}Please, stop reading the whole article about it… Could you just tell me the most important stuff in a nutshell? 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: …{{wi}} You are not a patient type, huh.
You: Wha?!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: As I was speaking…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: In the end, John Paul 202 created the most advanced operating system, programming language, AI and many more, as if possessed by the Holy Spirit himself. {{wi}}Disclaimer: this was never confirmed in the beatification process. 
...
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Many computer scientists tried to analyse his code, but it was really something else. He used techniques never seen before. They weren’t able to understand much. Excommunication of all Anaconda programmers wasn’t helping this cause.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: One of the fragments of code that they managed to decipher was a sorting algorithm with average computational complexity O(1). 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Let me repeat that again O(1) average computational complexity. Exclamation mark. 
You:...
Ecclesiasticalot FF: The algorithm didn’t need to read the elements. It somehow instantly knew how to put them in the right order as if God was doing it himself.
Why am I still here? He just talks and talks...
You: I told you to make it quick and you are still talking about every technical detail there is. I’m not an IT guy so I don’t understand all this smartish stuff.
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceAngry
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I already skipped some important details for your convenience. Shortening this story anymore would impact the overall message. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: If this length is too much for you there’s always a wikipedia page about it. 
Did I piss him off? There’s no way, right? It’s just a bunch of wires. 
Let’s just hear it to the end.{{wi}} This walking ‘audiobook’ is still better than reading it myself.
You: Ok, I get it. Please continue…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: …
#Priestbot.Face.botFaceNeutral
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Ekhm. Compiler, operating system and algorithms created by John Paul 202 from scratch had a huge impact on science. Some doubters even accused the Vatican of fabricating their results.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Nevertheless that didn’t stop development of the first Ecclesiasticalot FF. In 2019 the software side of this project was already done. Hardware and design was supposed to be chosen on the next ecumenical council.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Sadly, the mysterious death of John Paul 202 cut these plans short and brought great sorrow on every believer. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Next pope, Pius XXX took it on himself to finish the work of his predecessor.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Soon after first Ecclesiasticalot FF was deployed. Despite critics bashing its looks it was a great success. Thanks to features like free courses of programming in HolyC if you are baptized, the church acquired many new members.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Big batch of Ecclesiasticalots was intercepted by unknown forces in the South China Sea. The biggest suspect, China, never admitted involvement, but after their big breakthrough in computer science and AI the following year spoke for itself. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Then Pius XXX took action. He wanted to upload every line of code written by John Paul 202 to GeetHab.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Some bishops were furious about this plan and in 2021 they almost forced Pius XXX to abdicate. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: These are the most essential points of the story. Do you want to learn more?
You: No thanks.
Well… {{wi}}That’s a lot of knowledge that I will never use. 
You: Are you here alone? This place looks abandoned. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Yes. Human priests are a rarity in this country. Average age of the remaining priests is 78.
78? So it’s only old geezers. Now that I really think about it I never saw a young priest. The one in my home town was probably something like 65 too. 
You: That’s pretty strange.
